title: Corgi: The Game
tagline: Corgi the game is a game based on Corgi character using Corgi meme coin
description:
•⁠  ⁠Gamers mine Corgi Coin by playing the game

•⁠  ⁠Think of a meme coin with utility that’s Corgi Coin

•⁠  ⁠Players would be tempted to collect maximum coins during the mining phase

•⁠  ⁠⁠Users can buy limited amount of live savers per week against  a fixed amount of Corgi Coins

•⁠  ⁠⁠Custom Marketplace to Buy and swap Corgi Coins

*Weekly Tournaments*

•⁠  ⁠To participate users deposit 100 Corgi Coins and fight to reach the top 3 spots in the leaderboard

•⁠  ⁠The user highest score determines the position on leaderboard, so users would be tempted to buy live savers using Corgi Coin

•⁠  Total score determines Level and in game super powers based on levels which helps to improve High score
how_its_made:
The game is designed in JavaScript and revolves around Corgi Character. The smart contracts are built in Solidity programming language. 
Since we aren't expert in character design, so we made use of some online tools (https://www.pixelicious.xyz/) to convert images into pixel images to convert images to PNG we used (https://www.remove.bg/upload) and to animate the characters so made use of Google Slides.
